title: Add the Reviews landing screen and the builder screen-state machine
description: Introduce an internal screen-state enum (reviews | pulling | builder) inside MbrBuilderView under the single existing DEV-gated #mbr route, defaulting to a Reviews hub. Reviews shows the next-unstarted-month card and the Published list of locked months, each with a View action that navigates to #locked/<id>. The next month is max on-disk snapshot period + 1 calendar month (wall-clock month only as a cold-start fallback); if a draft already exists for that month the card resumes it without re-seeding. Ports the start-card / review-row / review-list / new-pill / section-label CSS from the mockup into src/styles.css. Visual unobtrusiveness is not in play; the mockup states the exact look.

rationale: The screen-state machine is the backbone every other builder screen plugs into, and Reviews is its default state; slicing it first gives a real landing surface and the View path (shared LockedMBR renderer, ADR-004) without dragging the whole builder in.

'Continue to builder' enables once every bucket row has finished and opens the builder for that month with the pulled values; Cancel returns to Reviews non-destructively (the pulled draft stays persisted on disk). Ports the collect-row / cdot / cname / ccount / chip-slot / state-chip.queued CSS from the mockup.

title: Redress the builder shell, head, draft banner, autosave and progress
description: Rebuild the builder screen chrome: head with eyebrow 'Monthly Business Review', title 'MBR builder · {month}', and the new subtitle; a toolbar carrying only Preview and the amber 'Lock month' primary (buttons wired in later tickets); the draft banner with 'Draft — changes are saved locally as you go.', a 'Last edited … · N of 5 buckets complete' meta, and a 'Discard draft' button; and the overall 'Insights added — N of M KPIs' progress bar. Each bucket card header shows the bucket name, an 'N KPIs' count, and a right-aligned 'N of M insights'; the column header reads KPI / This month / Status / Insight; each KPI's insight textarea edits and autosaves (a ~500ms debounced whole-snapshot PUT via saveSnapshot). Remove the old 'New MBR'/'Refresh all data'/trailing-status toolbar and the 'MBR builder · Draft' eyebrow, and drop the builder-local theme toggle so the builder follows the app global theme. Rows keep their existing value/status columns for now; t-004..t-008 enrich them. Update the existing MbrBuilderView shell/restyle tests to the new chrome.

Render the mockup's 'Carried' pill (clock icon + 'Carried') beside a KPI name in the builder iff origin==='carried', so it survives a draft reload; t-007 (manual edit → 'manual') and t-008 (collect → 'collected') clear it. Port the carried-badge CSS from the mockup.

The origin field is persisted on the draft snapshot so the Carried pill renders correctly after a draft reload rather than from ephemeral UI state

title: Render the This-month value cell with delta vs last MBR
description: Build the builder's 'This month' value cell for Auto KPIs: a bold tabular scalar with the free-text 'target N' from the KPI definition and an 'Auto' tag, or, for a multi-value KPI, the full cohort breakdown (label/value per source) with a per-source delta arrow and a 'change vs last MBR' caption. Compute the delta 'vs last MBR' as this-month value minus the value in latestLockedSnapshot (matched by KPI id; sub-deltas by SubReading.label), rendered up/down/flat and auto-recomputing on any value change. A KPI/source with no baseline (first-ever month, new or dropped source, non-differenceable value) renders an explicit —/'new' marker rather than a from-zero or percentage delta; a KPI with no target renders target as '—' and neutral. Port the value-cell / value-line / val-scalar / val-target / delta / cohort-list sub-delta / cohort-caption CSS.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A KPI with no target renders its target as '—'/'no target yet' and a neutral status seed
acceptanceCriteria.drawnAt: #screen-builder, the Cost per service value cell showing 'no target yet'

acceptanceCriteria.text: The delta is computed as this-month value minus the value in latestLockedSnapshot (matched by KPI id, sub-deltas by SubReading.label) and auto-recomputes whenever the value changes

A KPI or source with no baseline (first-ever month, new or dropped source, non-differenceable value) renders an explicit —/'new' marker and keeps both new and dropped source rows visible, never a from-zero or percentage delta
acceptanceCriteria.notDrawn: the mockup shows only populated deltas; the explicit no-baseline —/'new' marker is required behaviour the drawing does not depict

rationale: The value + computed delta is one cohesive provenance behavior (ADR-003) covering both scalar and cohort shapes; isolating the read-only value rendering and the delta math keeps the collect-cycle and manual-edit tickets focused on their own state transitions.

Off-track renders as an X silhouette distinct in shape from the on-track circle so colourblind readers tell them apart on shape alone; add the status-dot--x (X) shape to the app so it maps the 'negative' status. Port the status-cell / status-select / status-dot.x CSS.

title: Add the inline manual value editor seeded from the default view
description: For a Manual KPI (empty aiUpdateInstructions), render the value as an editable inline input with its unit and 'target N', seeded from the latest value on the default scorecard view, a 'From default view · edit to override' prefill note, and a 'Manual' tag; a value still needing entry renders the amber needs-entry treatment. A manual KPI whose value is a multi-value cohort (SubReading[]) renders each source as its own editable per-source input (reusing the existing ManualValueEditor cohort mode), not a read-only cohort, so the manual-AND-multi-value case has an owner. Editing autosaves (via t-003's debounced path), stamps origin 'manual' (clearing the Carried pill), and auto-recomputes the delta — with no per-KPI 'Lock in value'/'As of' step. Port the value-input / value-input.needs / unit / prefill-note / tag-manual CSS.

It also owns the manual-AND-multi-value intersection that neither the scalar-manual (this ticket) nor the read-only-cohort (t-005) slice otherwise settles, resolving it to editable per-source inputs.

title: Add the per-KPI Auto collect cycle
description: Give each Auto (wired) KPI its own collection control cycling Collect → Collecting… → ✓ Updated → Re-collect (Try again on failure), matching the Update KPIs page vocabulary (state chips, spinner). A collect posts to /__collect/:kpiId via collectKpi; on success it applies the fresh value + asOf, shows a 'was <old> · as of <date>' line, stamps origin 'collected' (clearing the Carried pill), and auto-recomputes the delta; on failure it shows 'Collection failed' with Try again. Reuse the shipping UpdateKpisView collect vocabulary/classes; port collect-line / state-chip.collecting / spinner / val-updated / val-old / asof / fail-reason as needed.

title: Add the per-month lock gate, Lock modal, and locked appearance
description: Make 'Lock month' a per-month lock gated on every KPI carrying a non-empty (trimmed) insight: the amber button is disabled until the gate is met. Clicking it opens a centered overlay dialog (over a dimmed backdrop, with a lock icon badge) titled 'Lock {month}?' summarising insight coverage ('N of M KPIs have an insight · N still empty'), dismissable via Cancel/Esc/backdrop; the old 'Locked by' handle field and the 'insight-less KPIs still publish' note are dropped. Confirming sets the whole month status to 'locked' and every bucket renders the read-only 'Locked' look together (Locked badge, read-only value/status/insight text), persisting via saveSnapshot. Per ADR-002 the lock is per-month only: the mockup's per-bucket 'Locked' chrome is presentation of the one month lock, so the drawn mixed state (some buckets locked while others stay editable) is not reproducible and every bucket flips together. Retain the lockedBy/amendments schema fields (optional, unused at write time) for historical rendering. Establishes the shared .overlay/.modal/.modal-head/.modal-icon/.modal-body/.modal-foot CSS and locked-bucket styling; update the existing lock tests to the month-level, no-handle, no-note model.
